}

			has_reform = government_reform:antq_regional_kingship
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_petition_court
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_frontier_muster_monarchy
		}
	}
	country_modifier = {
		global_burghers_estate_power = 0.10
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.05
		estate_power_from_cabinet = 0.20
		set_cabinet_member_cost_modifier = -0.05
	}
	on_activate = {
		set_parliament_type = parliament_type:antq_royal_council
	}
	years = 2
}

antq_frontier_muster_monarchy = {
	major = yes
	government = monarchy
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_client_monarchy
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_buffer_kingdom
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_regional_kingship
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_petition_court
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_frontier_muster_monarchy
		}
	}
	country_modifier = {
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.15
		global_tribes_estate_power = 0.05
		nobles_estate_power_from_cabinet = 0.25
		replace_cabinet_member_cost_modifier = 0.10
	}
	on_activate = {
		set_parliament_type = parliament_type:antq_royal_council
	}
	years = 2
}
